note: Private rafting outpost on the Upper Colorado River at State Bridge, ~20 acres of riverside camping with standard and premium RV sites, car-camping, walk-in and group sites, and cabins. Boat ramp/raft put-in, vehicle shuttles and gear rental. Access via Trough Road (Grand County Rd 1, the Colorado River Headwaters Scenic Byway), a maintained gravel road -- passable by 2WD when dry (rutted/slick after heavy rain). No cell service (Wi-Fi calls work; landline at the store). --Claude
summary: Operator site + Newbook: live (970-653-4431 matches), sells Standard/Basic and Premium RV sites to a 'Motorhome' equipment type at $45/$49 midweek and $57/$63 Saturdays (2027), one-night minimum on campsites. Confirmed dry camping (no hookups), no dump, jug-only potable water, store; added Wi-Fi, fees, platform/url. Cleared the review-derived 35-ft max (no operator statement). Note: dropped the hookup/dump/water/max-length/'reservable' restatements and the wrong '2-night weekend minimum' (that is the cabins'); replaced '~12 RV sites' (the engine shows 8 standard + 7 premium available on one date). Season not stated (the FAQ calls it a 'short operating season', peak June-September). Not stayed at; no gateway within 40 km (Rocky Mountain NP 78 km).
flags: Price gate: base (Standard/Basic RV Site midweek) is $45, under US$50; Saturdays are $57 ($63 Premium). No gateway within 40 km; the family has not stayed here. Quotes were for 1 adult (sites hold up to 4).
